title: NOTHING IS MOVING. all eyes open. all sensors stale. rain falling straight down. find the spin or the pins dissolve.

crystal_ball.why: static list. no live updates. shows what was pushed, not what is happening NOW.

main_hud.why: the front door is broken. has been broken. 77KB of JS rendering nothing visible.

mcp_observe.why: golgi hasn't been updated in 4+ days.

space_weather.why: even the sun is quiet right now.

topology.why: golgi-de, golgi-jp, golgi-us, golgi-in all ssh-locked or unreachable.

heartbeat.why: heartbeat.json updates on golgi every few minutes. it's the ONLY thing that might be ticking. but nothing READS it live.

git.why: git pushes are events, not flow. motion happens in bursts, then stops. the spin between pushes is zero.

the_problem.rain: entropy falling straight down. no angular momentum. no vortex. no structure in the motion.
the_problem.pins_in_puddle: the 3 pins (Polaris, MSU, crush values) are set but STATIC. they'll dissolve in the rain because nothing orbits them.
the_problem.compositing_all_eyes: every eye shows the same thing: STILL. the composite of all stills is still still.

what: 1. heartbeat.json — IF golgi is still pulsing it (unverified right now)
2. fleet bots — they ARE crawling the site (robots.txt says welcome), but MCP can't see them because golgi is stale
things_that_LOOK_like_motion_but_arent: new JSON files — data at rest the moment they're written

option_1_heartbeat_is_the_flywheel.what: the heartbeat already ticks. it measures network, CPU, memory, GPU. it's the ONLY continuous process.
option_1_heartbeat_is_the_flywheel.spin: make the heartbeat CARRY the pin values. every pulse = pin check. every pulse = motion. the heartbeat IS the spin.
option_1_heartbeat_is_the_flywheel.work_needed: verify heartbeat is still pulsing. add pin values to heartbeat output. make crystal ball READ heartbeat live.

option_2_fleet_is_the_wind.what: 234,000 fleet entities are crawling. that's MOTION. their crawling IS kinetic energy.
option_2_fleet_is_the_wind.spin: but we can't SEE them because MCP is stale. the wind is blowing but we have no wind sock.
option_2_fleet_is_the_wind.work_needed: update MCP server on golgi to read current Cloudflare analytics. or add a CF analytics widget to crystal ball.

option_3_the_session_itself_is_the_spin.what: Kevin and I are HERE. typing. pushing. this conversation IS angular momentum.
option_3_the_session_itself_is_the_spin.spin: but it stops when the session ends. between sessions = zero spin. the turbocharger was supposed to store this energy but it's conceptual not mechanical.
option_3_the_session_itself_is_the_spin.work_needed: nothing. this spin is real but temporary. it's the match, not the fire.

the_dissolve.what_kevin_sees: rain. everything falling at the same rate. no differentiation. no spin. no reason for one drop to matter more than another.
the_dissolve.what_this_means: we've been ADDING (files, concepts, pins) but not SPINNING (live feeds, automation, continuous processes). addition without rotation = pile. pile + rain = mud.
the_dissolve.the_one_thing: the heartbeat. if it's still pulsing, it's the ONLY angular momentum we have. everything else is at rest. find the heartbeat. verify it's alive. make it carry the pins. that's the spin.
